epics.title: Live provider model discovery
epics.objective: Expose provider-advertised models without replacing Gantry's durable alias catalog.

tasks.title: Discover and safely register provider models
tasks.objective: Add bounded live model discovery and explicit registration through the existing settings-owned alias catalog, while retaining configured aliases when providers fail or omit models and snapshotting resolved identity on new runs.
acceptance_criteria: Configured Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, and OpenRouter accounts expose bounded live model listings merged with all registered aliases.
A user can explicitly register a discovered model through a settings desired-state revision and then select its alias through existing runtime paths.
Discovery failure or omission never deletes saved aliases or history, and new runs retain immutable resolved model identity snapshots.
Raw provider model IDs remain invalid selectors and unavailable execution never silently falls back.
tasks.reviewer_focus: Credential isolation and bounded outbound requests; settings revision conflict safety; non-destructive omission and failure semantics; single catalog resolver integration; nullable run-history migration safety.
